name: fly-escape
description: Help the Fly Escape — local 3D browser game

scripts.build: bun run types:generate && bun run assets:brain && bun run assets:retina && bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/asset-lab build
scripts.test: bun run test:graph && bun run test:reference && cargo test && bun run test:client && bun run test:renderer && bun run test:assets && bun run test:web
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/brain.mjs && node tests/browser/fields.mjs && node tests/browser/lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:setup: bun test apps/web/src/progress.test.ts && node tests/browser/setup.mjs && node tests/browser/setup-commit.mjs
scripts.test:retina-record: bun test packages/sim-client/src/record.test.ts packages/sim-client/src/record-errors.test.ts packages/sim-client/src/retina-record.test.ts && bun tests/retina-record-memory.ts && node tests/browser/retina-record-wasm.mjs && node tests/browser/retina-record.mjs
